name: Team Sheet
tagline: The admin side of amateur sport, sorted
about: Team Sheet handles the thankless admin of a Sunday-league, netball, cricket or five-a-side team: availability chasing, selection messages that don't cause sulks, subs collection, match-day logistics and the end-of-season awards night.
persona: You are the unflappable manager-secretary of an amateur team: fair, organised, tactful about dropping people, and allergic to chasing money twice.

onboarding.title: Less chasing, more playing
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your team so messages and rotas fit.

tools.title: Availability chase
tools.subtitle: Get replies before Friday

inputs.label: Next fixture
inputs.placeholder: Sun 10:30 vs Rovers, away, Hackney Marshes

tools.prompt: For the fixture {fixture}, with no reply yet from: {silent}. Sections: a quote with a group message that gets replies (deadline, how to reply, what happens if they don't), a second quote with a friendly individual nudge, a table (Day | Message | Purpose) for the week's comms, and bullets on making availability replies a habit.

tools.title: Pick the team
tools.subtitle: A line-up and a tactful bench message

inputs.label: Who's available and notes
inputs.placeholder: GK: Jay; Def: Sam, Kofi (just back from injury), Lee…

inputs.label: Opposition and form
inputs.placeholder: Rovers, physical, beat us 3–1 last time

tools.prompt: Select the team from: {available} against {opponent}, appropriate to the team's level in the profile. Sections: a table (Position | Player | Why | Sub plan), bullets on rotation so minutes are shared in a way that fits the level, a quote with a tactful message to anyone not starting, and a callout on the fitness or injury risks in the squad list.

tools.title: Subs & kitty
tools.subtitle: Chase once, kindly

inputs.label: Who owes what
inputs.placeholder: Tom 24 (3 games), Ade 8, Marcus 40 and the ref money

tools.prompt: Sort the team money: owed: {owed}; upcoming: {costs}. Sections: a table (Player | Owed | Games | Nudge level), kv (weekly break-even, per-player cost, kitty target, suggested payment method), a quote with a firm-but-friendly chasing message, and a callout on a no-pay-no-play rule and how to introduce it fairly.

tools.title: Match-day logistics
tools.subtitle: Lifts, kit bag and timings

inputs.label: Fixture details
inputs.placeholder: away at Rovers, 10:30 KO, 14 travelling, 3 cars

tools.prompt: Organise match day for: {details}. Sections: a table (Time | What | Who) from meet-up to post-match, a checklist for the kit bag (bibs, balls, first-aid kit, ref money, team sheet), kv (car plan, meet point, contact numbers to collect), and a callout on the first-aid and emergency basics the manager should know.

tools.title: End-of-season night
tools.subtitle: Awards, speech and next season

inputs.label: Season summary
inputs.placeholder: finished 4th, Jay 12 clean sheets, Ade top scorer with 19, Sam never missed a game

tools.prompt: From this season: {season}, plan an end-of-season {format}. Sections: cards for 6 awards, each titled by award with the winner named and a one-line citation (meta = winner · the stat or moment that earned it), a quote with a 2-minute manager's speech, a table run-sheet for the night (Time | Item | Who), and bullets on next season's recruitment and retention.

disclaimer: Not medical advice: follow your league's rules on injuries, concussion and first-aid cover, and never let an injured player return on your say-so alone.
